seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The show continues its journey from "ordinary nobody" to "King of Comedy," bringing together outstanding stand-up comedians and manzai duos from comedy clubs across the country. Each "ordinary nobody" takes the stage with authenticity and vibrant energy. Refusing to be limited or defined, they thrive freely in the world of comedy, growing on their own terms as they strive to become a one-of-a-kind King of Comedy.
